title: Data, Model & Experiment Lineage
interviewAnswer: ML lineage records which data snapshot, feature definitions, code commit, configuration, environment and artifact produced a model version so it can be reproduced and audited.
why: Without lineage, rollback and debugging become guesswork.
intuition: A file named final_v7.pt is not enough to explain how it was created.
deepDive: A reproducible run pins source commit, data/version identifiers, preprocessing schema, hyperparameters, environment and metrics. Exact floating-point reproducibility may still vary on GPU hardware.
commonMistakes: Equating a random seed with complete reproducibility.
Versioning model weights but not data/preprocessing.
followUps: What belongs in a model registry?
production: Capture lineage automatically through pipelines and define retention for audit/rollback needs.
workedExample: When v42 regresses, lineage lets you compare it with v41 rather than reconstruct history manually.
